sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# The RIGHT actions stopped working after the white blocks reached their limit
# Let me try ACTION7 to see what it does
result = action(['ACTION7'])
print("ACTION7 result:")
print("  gameplay_changed:", last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed'))
print("  level_completed:", last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
print("  board_changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))

# Check what changed
if last_transition:
    before = last_transition.before_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    after = last_transition.after_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    
    before_map = {}
    for n in before:
        k = (n['color'], n['pixels'], n['hash'])
        b = n['boundary']
        minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
        minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
        before_map[k] = (minr, minc)

    after_map = {}
    for n in after:
        k = (n['color'], n['pixels'], n['hash'])
        b = n['boundary']
        minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
        minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
        after_map[k] = (minr, minc)

    print("=== Objects that moved ===")
    for k in before_map:
        if k in after_map and before_map[k] != after_map[k]:
            print("  color=%s, px=%d: before=(%d,%d) -> after=(%d,%d)" % (k[0], k[1], before_map[k][0], before_map[k][1], after_map[k][0], after_map[k][1]))

    print("=== New objects ===")
    for k in after_map:
        if k not in before_map:
            print("  color=%s, px=%d at (%d,%d)" % (k[0], k[1], after_map[k][0], after_map[k][1]))

    print("=== Removed objects ===")
    for k in before_map:
        if k not in after_map:
            print("  color=%s, px=%d was at (%d,%d)" % (k[0], k[1], before_map[k][0], before_map[k][1]))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
